entry.summary:
The New Zealand Symphony Orchestra performs Ein Heldenleben (A Hero's Life), Op. 40 by Richard Strauss, conducted by Stéphane Denève.

Watch more NZSO performances on NZSO+: https://nzso.co.nz/plus
